title: The Mind of a Child: Void of Ego and Pride
body:
IUIC in the ClassRoom · 2026-09-12

Opens [Ps 19](/bible/psalms/19) · [Prov 12](/bible/proverbs/12) · [Sir 22](/bible/sirach/22) · [Isa 46](/bible/isaiah/46) · [Isa 13](/bible/isaiah/13) · [Isa 14](/bible/isaiah/14) · [Matt 18](/bible/matthew/18) · [Matt 20](/bible/matthew/20) · [Luke 12](/bible/luke/12) · [Mark 7](/bible/mark/7) · [James 4](/bible/james/4) · [Mark 9](/bible/mark/9) · [Phil 2](/bible/philippians/2) · [James 5](/bible/james/5) · [3 John 1](/bible/3-john/1) · [Gal 5](/bible/galatians/5) · and 11 more below
## Introduction All praise to the Most High. We are in this building. I have not been in New York in a minute. Shout out to Captain Yahn, in the building — we have got so many captains, we are growing so much now, the rotation is like every five months. And a special shout out to Captain Hananiah in town. All praises. It is good to be back in New York. I have had this topic on my mind for at least two, three weeks: the mind of a child, void of ego and pride. But while I am putting the topic together, I am watching the news and I see the Houthis dropping, took over Saudi Arabia, and all types of crazy stuff going on. So this class I have got to touch on that a little, and then I am going into the lesson, the mind of a child. I have got to touch on what is going on in Yemen and Saudi Arabia. The thumbnail says it: to truly see, we must first unlearn. We must return to the beginning, to a place where strength is found in listening, and true leadership begins with submission. Yet the world demands ego. It feeds on pride. It rewards the loudest voice and mocks the quiet heart. But that is the trap, the snare that blinds the soul. So step back, question what you have been taught, find the truth, restore the mind. Verily I say unto you, except ye be converted and become as little children, you will never see as clearly as you were meant to see. ## In The News First, wisdom for the week. The wisdom for the week is: are you a stupid person? I am going to show you how not to be a stupid person. Pay attention to these signs, whether or not you are a stupid person. > Seven signs of a stupid person. You may want to save this video for later and pass this on to someone who needs it. > > One, a constant need to be right. People who cannot consider other perspectives or admit they might be wrong reveal low self-awareness. They reject feedback and stay stuck. > > Two, blaming others for everything. Instead of owning their actions, they shift responsibility onto anyone but themselves, which keeps them from growing. > > Three, talking more than listening. They dominate conversations, ignore what others say, and care more about their own voice than learning anything new. > > Four, refusing to learn. Whether it is avoiding challenges or dismissing advice, a closed mind keeps them stagnant while smarter people stay curious and adaptable. > > Five, overconfidence without substance. They act like experts without knowledge or experience, often speaking impulsively and exposing their lack of depth. > > Six, judging others too quickly. Snap assumptions and stereotypes show a lack of empathy and almost always lead to unfair conclusions and strained relationships. > > Seven, the perpetual complainer. Complaining as a form of action: they identify problems but offer no solutions. Zero tolerance for anyone who suggests effort. A stupid person points out what is wrong; a smart person finds a way to fix it. - A constant need to be right. You have got to be right all the time, you are never wrong. Some of you right now might be saying, damn, that is me. So guess what — you might be a stupid person. Some of you sisters in the house, you are always right, you always argue with your husband. - You have low self-awareness. You cannot examine yourself and see, listen, I am wrong. You reject any feedback from anyone and you stay stuck. As I said, these classes are for examination and for healing. So if you fall under that category, you could fix it. - The blame game. You are always blaming someone for everything that goes wrong. You do not want to take responsibility for your actions or the role you play in whatever messed-up decision or bad thing happened. Somebody comes to you and says, yo man, you did me wrong, and you say, no, I did you wrong because you did this to me. - Talking more than listening. Some people just be talking. It is all about them: I, I, I. That type of person is a stupid person, because you should be able to sit down and learn. - Refusing to learn. When brothers and sisters give you advice according to the scriptures and you do not follow that advice or that counsel — that is why I tell you I will counsel you twice, that is it, twice on the same matter. And if you have not followed the counsel I gave you, do not come to me again, because what that shows me is that you are a stupid person. I have not got time for stupid people. - Overconfidence without substance. You act like you know everything and you have not got any experience. You are just running your mouth because you want to look good. Have you seen these videos — how to become a millionaire, one, quit your job. I do not take advice from somebody that is not successful. You should not be listening to them about how to acquire property and houses. They have no substance to show. - Judging others too quickly. One thing I learned in this truth — some of these things I fell under at one point in time. Sometimes brothers and sisters come to me and say, yo deacon, this happened and the brother did this and that, and I judge the brother or curse him out without even hearing his part. Then I find out the person that brought it to me brought wrong information. Guess what that makes me? I was a stupid person. I watch the brother like, bro, you made me look stupid, you brought this baloney. - So I learned: I am not judging anything without two or three witnesses. I am not listening to any of you. Bring two or three witnesses. Bishop said, stop talking to these people by themselves, you need two of them, husband and wife. I did not follow that, and I ended up looking stupid. So brothers, do not be quick to judge matters. People misunderstand, and people also lie. You could have misheard, or you are lying, and then I run and I judge that person wrongfully and I look stupid. A couple of people cannot stand me — yo, this dude judged me wrongfully. I said, I am sorry, man. And I did not know they still hold on to it. - The perpetual complainer. I told my wife straight: do not come to me with complaints. If you have not got a solution, you have got to bring a solution. A smart person is going to see a problem and come up with a solution; a stupid person is going to see a problem and complain. - Let me give an example. A wife realises there is a problem — my husband is always on the phone, he is not showing me much attention. A stupid woman is going to be angry and complain: you do not do this, you do not do that. What is a smart woman going to do? She puts on something real nice and walks by him. He is on his phone, and now he is going to put down that phone and follow her. What is going on, why are you dressed like that, is it a special day? Solutions. Or plan a date, make a nice dinner on the deck with some wine, and you just eat and chill. Solutions. The only time a brother is not going to respond to that is if that brother is a homosexual. - So that is the seven of them right there. Wisdom for the week: do not be stupid. And if you are stupid, God's law is going to fix you. It is going to convert you and make you wise. Then on Yemen and Saudi Arabia. A brief history: Yemen was controlled by the Shiites, one part split in the eighteenth century, one part ruled by Shiite Muslims and the other a colony for Britain and France. Around the nineties it unified. Then from 2014 to 2022 a civil war broke out. You had the Houthis — they call them rebels, but over there in Yemen they are called revolutionaries; rebels is a term the western world put on them. They rose up with the original ruler of that land, fighting against a government set up by America, France, Britain and Saudi Arabia, the one the UN recognises. Over 350,000 Yemenis died, and a lot of them died from starvation because the food supply was cut off by the US and Saudi Arabia. We do not know anything about that. And the only people helping and supporting Yemen was Iran. So how do you think the people in Yemen feel right now about America, Britain and Saudi Arabia? Their country was divided and a puppet government was set up. > Yemen celebrates battlefield victories over Saudi-backed forces. > > Iran just found a second chokehold on the world's oil supply. This time it is the Houthis who pulled it off, by taking full control of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, capturing the port of Mocha and the strategic Mayun Island, the one piece of land that splits this waterway in two. Whoever holds Mayun controls the strait. > > Here is why that matters. The Strait of Hormuz, where 20 to 25% of the world's oil and gas moves through, is already choked off by Iran. Now Bab el-Mandeb is gone too, and that is another 10% of global oil supply. Added up, over a third of the entire world's trade route is now under threat — controlled on one side by Iran and on the other by Iran's own proxy, the Houthis. > > Saudi Arabia is getting hit hardest. When Hormuz shut down, Saudi rerouted its oil through the East-West pipeline to bypass it entirely. Overnight, that pipeline was reportedly struck too. Saudi oil production has dropped to its lowest level in nearly three decades. Every ship that still wants to reach Europe now has to go the long way around Africa, burning more fuel, paying higher insurance, taking weeks longer. And fertiliser supplies, which also move through this route, are next. > > So if anyone tells you this war is winding down, look at the map. It just opened a second front. - The Houthis captured the Bab el-Mandeb Strait. Now all trade coming from the Suez Canal has got to go through that strait in order to go to West Asia. When Hormuz was cut off, what Saudi Arabia was doing was transporting its oil over land to this waterway and using that waterway to transport its oil all over the world. So now that waterway is shut down, and the Houthis took it. - Fertilisers — you need fertilisers for farming. So what is going to happen? Famine. - Oil is already past $116 a barrel, and it is projected to hit at least $200. That means food prices are going up. Everything we buy is going to go up. And Iran keeps warning Trump, but Trump does not want to listen. The pride of his heart has deceived him. That dude is a very prideful man. But God is allowing all of this to happen. - What does the Bible refer to this as? The beginning of sorrows, the beginning of famine. The Lord is behind all of this, and it is going to get worse and worse. Do not sit down and wait for things to get better. Those of you with money, you are supposed to be preparing. We need our own food supply, we need our water. There is a lot we need. - Then this clip of a Houthi soldier standing over the dead, pointing at his own people that they had to kill on the ground. > What do you want from us, O house of Saud? It is the impossible. We are free. We were born free. We shall live free. We shall die free. And never shall we be slaves to any of the tyrants of this earth. We will never submit to humiliation. - So the dragon has awoken. Ishmael, the dragons of Arabia, is waking up now. Because that is what Saudi was doing to Yemen from 2014 to this day. The country was divided by Europe and Saudi Arabia and the people over there were being exploited. Over two million people were displaced and over 350,000 died in that civil war. You do not hear anything about it. But guess who knows about it? The people over there. - Then Trump rejected the appeals from the Saudi Crown Prince for direct US military strikes against advancing Houthi forces, limiting involvement to intelligence sharing. So Saudi Arabia called up Trump and said, we need help. And Trump said, we are not helping you, you have got to fight that battle yourself. Guess what — that is what Iran was hoping. And the petrodollar, which is the deal underneath all of it: > Ever wonder how the US dollar became the world's most powerful currency? It all started with oil. In 1973, after the US left the gold standard, a secret deal was struck between the US and Saudi Arabia. The US, led by President Nixon and Secretary of State Henry Kissinger, agreed to provide military protection to Saudi Arabia. In return, the oil would only be sold in US dollars. This agreement, called the petrodollar system, required other countries to hold US dollars to buy oil, creating massive demand for the dollar globally. The petrodollar system solidified the US dollar as the world's reserve currency, giving America immense global power and influence for decades. - So the US was supposed to protect Saudi and give them weapons; that was the deal. Now Saudi is calling the US asking for protection, and the US is saying, you are on your own. Iran is showing the Arabs and the Saudis that America does not care about you. Remember the other day Trump was on national television saying the Saudi prince kisses his behind. - The whole world uses the US dollar to trade and buy oil from Saudi and other countries. Right now Saudi is selling no oil. What do you think is going to happen to the US dollar? Some of you have got millions of dollars in the bank — you are going to lose all of that. You are storing up your riches on this earth. This world is coming to an end. ## Scriptures Opened **[Psalms 19:7](/bible/psalms/19#v7)** *[[25:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZdJmxp6V1Ds&t=1552s)]* > [7](/bible/psalms/19#v7) The law of the Lord is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple. - The law of the Lord is perfect, converting the soul. God's laws are perfect, and it changes you. - The testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple. The simple is stupid people. So God's law changes stupid people. If you want to change, apply God's laws to your life. You want to stop being stupid, apply God's laws to your life. So if any one of you falls into those categories, just fix it. **[Proverbs 12:15](/bible/proverbs/12#v15)** *[[26:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZdJmxp6V1Ds&t=1612s)]* > [15](/bible/proverbs/12#v15) The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise. - The way of a fool is right in his own eyes. So if you are a fool, if you are stupid, what you do is always going to be right in your eyes. Remember one of the signs is that he is always right. Everybody else is telling you, you are wrong, but in your eyes, no, I am right. - But he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise. If you can take advice, if you can take correction, you are wise. That is what makes you wise. You see how God's law converts you. If you can take criticism even from your spouse — sisters, your husband is going to criticise you, he is going to tell you things you are doing that are not right. All you have got to do is listen. Do not fight against it. **[Proverbs 12:23](/bible/proverbs/12#v23)** *[[28:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZdJmxp6V1Ds&t=1680s)]* > [23](/bible/proverbs/12#v23) A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness. - A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness. If you are a fool, you are just going to talk foolishness, and your heart bears foolishness. What is that foolishness? Some of those seven things we just showed you. You do not want to take correction. You do not want to listen to anyone. You are arrogant. **[Proverbs 12:1](/bible/proverbs/12#v1)** *[[28:57](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZdJmxp6V1Ds&t=1737s)]* > [1](/bible/proverbs/12#v1) Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish. - Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge. If you love to be instructed, you love knowledge. - But he that hateth reproof is brutish. If you do not like to be corrected, if you do not like it when somebody tells you that was wrong what you did — the scripture says you are brutish. Brutish is stupid. Here is somebody trying to help you. You know you are doing something wrong, they say, that is wrong, stop doing that, and you hate that. You are a stupid person. **[Sirach 22:15](/bible/sirach/22#v15)** *[[29:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZdJmxp6V1Ds&t=1785s)]* > [15](/bible/sirach/22#v15) Sand, and salt, and a mass of iron, is easier to bear, than a man without understanding. - Sand, and salt, and a mass of iron, is easier to bear, than a man without understanding. The sand and the salt goes into back in the day — they would carry sand and salt, put it in bags, and it is very heavy. The same thing with iron; when you are carrying a mass of iron, iron is heavy. - So it is easier to bear these heavy things than to be around somebody that is just stupid. Why? Because they will argue with you all the time. They will never want to take the blame for what they did, and they will always cause confusion. It is easier to carry those heavy burdens than to deal with somebody that is a fool. **[Isaiah 46:9-10](/bible/isaiah/46#v9)** *[[32:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZdJmxp6V1Ds&t=1964s)]* > [9](/bible/isaiah/46#v9) Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me, > > [10](/bible/isaiah/46#v10) Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure: - Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me. - Declaring the end from the beginning. So the Lord declared the end, and the time we are living in right now is the end, but he did it from the beginning. - And from ancient times. From the time of Moses, Abraham, Adam. - The things that are not yet done. He lets us know the things that are not yet done. He let the prophets know what is going to happen. - Saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure. And what God said, his counsel, it shall stand. - So everything you see happening in the world today — what is happening in Russia and Ukraine, the earthquakes all over the world, what is happening with Iran and America, what is happening in Yemen and Saudi Arabia, in Lebanon, what you see happening in Palestine — God declared them all from the beginning. And it is amazing to see these things come to pass, because it builds your faith up. You say, this Bible is a real book. **[Isaiah 13:1](/bible/isaiah/13#v1)** *[[54:15](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZdJmxp6V1Ds&t=3255s)]* > [1](/bible/isaiah/13#v1) The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see. - The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see. When it says the burden of Babylon, the burden goes into the destruction or judgment God is going to bring on Babylon. So Isaiah saw the judgment of Babylon. - And this Babylon is not talking just about ancient Babylon. This is about the Babylon today, mystery Babylon, America. That is the Babylon that is being talked about here, and I am going to prove that to you. **[Isaiah 13:17-19](/bible/isaiah/13#v17)** *[[55:18](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZdJmxp6V1Ds&t=3318s)]* > [17](/bible/isaiah/13#v17) Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it. > > [18](/bible/isaiah/13#v18) Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children. > > [19](/bible/isaiah/13#v19) And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah. - Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them. God says to Babylon, I will stir up the Medes against you. The same way the ancient Medes and Persians were raised up to destroy ancient Babylon is the same way God is using modern-day Media and Persia, which is Iran, to weaken and to play a role in destroying mystery Babylon. It is like history repeating itself. - Which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it. So who is going to raise up the Iranians against America? God says, I will raise them up. And they are not going to care about money. You cannot pay them off. Trump said we are going to give you $500 billion — Iran does not care about money. Guess who cares about money? Saudi Arabia. They were trying to build this big glass city in the desert. That is done, that is not happening. - When Trump went over there and killed the Ayatollah and all those men, kids, his wife, his kids — what do you think is going through these people's minds now? They want vengeance. Their whole mission and state of mind now is to destroy Babylon. - Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces. Their bows goes into their missiles, showing that the Medes are going to have some bad missiles. That is why you see Iran is so good at creating these ballistic missiles, because according to the prophecy, their bows shall dash the young men to pieces. - And they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eyes shall not spare children. This is going into Armageddon. This is when Iran gets its own back. - And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees' excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah. How did God overthrow Sodom and Gomorrah? With fire and brimstone. So this is also showing that Iran will eventually acquire nuclear capability. Babylon the glory of kingdoms is talking about America, mystery Babylon. - The way Iran is doing it is asymmetric warfare: a military conflict between opposing forces with a significant imbalance in power, resources or technology, where the weaker side uses unconventional tactics to exploit the stronger side's weaknesses. America is much more powerful than Iran, so Iran is using unconventional tactics to weaken America, and the Most High God is behind that. - And that is the same way the ancient Medes destroyed ancient Babylon. Cyrus the Great conquered ancient Babylon in 539 BC using a mix of military strategy, engineering and political diplomacy, rather than a costly frontal assault. Ancient Babylon was overthrown from within. That is asymmetric warfare. That is exactly what Iran is doing today: weakening America's economy, causing division among the politicians. **[Isaiah 14:1-4](/bible/isaiah/14#v1)** *[[1:08:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZdJmxp6V1Ds&t=4121s)]* > [1](/bible/isaiah/14#v1) For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob. > > [2](/bible/isaiah/14#v2) And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the Lord for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors. > > [3](/bible/isaiah/14#v3) And it shall come to pass in the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve, > > [4](/bible/isaiah/14#v4) That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased! - When Isaiah wrote this, did he write it and put chapter 13, chapter 14? It was a continual vision. So chapter 14 is a continuation of chapter 13, the same vision concerning Babylon. - For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land. So after Babylon is destroyed, God will have mercy upon Jacob, he is going to choose us, and he is going to put us back in our land. - And the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob. They are going to be our servants. - And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the Lord for servants and handmaids. Everybody is going back to their own land, and all nations are going to serve us. When is this going to happen? After Babylon is destroyed. - And they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors. Are we captives here in America? Yes we are. We are going to rule over our oppressors. - And it shall come to pass in the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve. So when the Lord gives us rest from the hard bondage, what Isaiah saw is us in rest. He saw us delivered up out of here. He saw us in the kingdom, ruling the earth in righteousness. - That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon. Those of us that make it, we are going to take up a proverb against America. - And say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased! So we are going to say, how have the oppressor, which is America, ceased? How was America destroyed? Are we asking, or are we making a statement? We are making a statement. So everything else we are about to read explains how America was destroyed. **[Isaiah 14:5-8](/bible/isaiah/14#v5)** *[[1:15:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZdJmxp6V1Ds&t=4502s)]* > [5](/bible/isaiah/14#v5) The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers. > > [6](/bible/isaiah/14#v6) He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth. > > [7](/bible/isaiah/14#v7) The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing. > > [8](/bible/isaiah/14#v8) Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us. - The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers. Who is saying this? We are saying it. God has broken the staff of the wicked and the sceptre of the rulers. - He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke. So America smote the nations in wrath. - He that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth. That is what America did. - The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing. So when he is destroyed, the whole earth is going to be at rest and quiet. - Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee. So what we are reading about already happened — America is already destroyed in chapter 13, and now he is explaining how the golden city ceased. **[Isaiah 14:9-11](/bible/isaiah/14#v9)** *[[1:15:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZdJmxp6V1Ds&t=4551s)]* > [9](/bible/isaiah/14#v9) Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations. > > [10](/bible/isaiah/14#v10) All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us? > > [11](/bible/isaiah/14#v11) Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, and the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee. - Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth. In chapter 13 he says God is going to raise up the Medes against thee. Now Isaiah is going a little more in depth. All the chief ones of the earth are going to be stirred up to come against America. - Why is everybody going to be stirred up against America? Because of what America is doing now. America went and assassinated the Iranian leaders and the Ayatollahs. What America has done and is doing will usher the world into a financial collapse, and the nations will hate America for it. Europe will hate America, because that war America started with Iran is going to affect Europe very badly. - It hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations. All the kings of the nations are going to rise up against America. - All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? So this is not when they are destroyed. We are going to say, have they become as weak as us? Showing that America will become weak economically and militarily, and the nations will see that, and that is why they will rise up and destroy this place. Because America will lose its world economic power and its military dominance. - The military dominance America had for years — who helped America with that? The NATO alliance. All the European countries supported America in all the evil they were doing from 1945 all the way until Trump came into office. Trump came into office and disrespected all the Europeans, started putting tariffs on them. - Art thou become like unto us? Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, and the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee. So before America is destroyed, America will become weak. And this is the beginning stages of America's decline. **[Isaiah 14:17-19](/bible/isaiah/14#v17)** *[[1:21:01](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZdJmxp6V1Ds&t=4861s)]* > [17](/bible/isaiah/14#v17) That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners? > > [18](/bible/isaiah/14#v18) All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house. > > [19](/bible/isaiah/14#v19) But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet. - That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners. Because America made the world a wilderness. What made you fall? Because you were destroying nations. You made nations a wilderness, and the kings of the earth rose up, they saw you became weak, and they rose up against you. - All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house. So America is already destroyed.
